name: Jariel
source:
Elven bard.

In elven culture, bards are not only entertainers but also keepers of lore and wisdom.

In that respect, Jariel is a paragon: he is currently in the twenty-fourth year of his Century Journey, a hundred years of his life he exclusively devoted to the exploration of the world and the gathering of new knowledge.

A seasoned traveler, Jariel is not only an important asset in any fight but has considerable social skills that often help him talk his way out of dangerous situations with diplomacy and intelligence. He often accompanies groups of adventurers he believes will experience interesting things on their travels.

However, what is interesting to Jariel may prove deadly to his fellow travelers...

[From [url=http://www.winterwolves.net/viewtopic.php?f=40&t=3053]Winter Wolves[/url]]
